experiment.title: Measure real expert reuse
experiment.implementation: Diagnostic entry point and capture/parser staged; native CPU self-test passes. No model or GPU run yet.
experiment.hypothesis: Four/five verification tokens may reuse enough selected experts to justify sparse matrix work.
experiment.only_change: Install a read-only evaluation callback for ten expert IDs per token; preserve weight bytes and all launchers.
proof: Matched greedy text and token IDs including warmups
Ten distinct IDs per token in 0..511
experiment.limits: Callbacks split/synchronize graphs. Exclude their timing from TPS history. A high reuse rate alone does not prove a fast kernel.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
